dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral flank exhibit a high-frequency gradient transition from dark base-tone pixels to high-intensity silver-white perimeters. The rings range in width from 2 to 6 pixels, surrounding mid-tone gray cores with irregular internal textures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Densely packed clusters of solid, high-intensity white blobs are concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region. These clusters lack internal luminance gradients and are separated by thin interstices of low-intensity dark pixels, creating a high-frequency mosaic pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral 'O' rings form a scalene triangle. The longest side of this triangle is oriented approximately 15 degrees from the longitudinal axis, while the shortest side connects the mid-body 'O' ring to a ventral-leaning 'C' shaped structure.
